discovery_budget.discovery: knit_a still emits a jlink/ModuleLayer root set that includes the app and api units but omits the SPI provider unit (and does not bind services), so jlink launch boots while ServiceLoader leaves spi_bound false
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the omitted module root collapses jlink work to a one-line add-modules edit.

discovery_budget.discovery: fold_b relocates io.helix.bridge.* into io.helix.internal.bridge.* while the JNI shared library still FindClass-es io/helix/bridge/NativeHook, so JVM jni_bridge fails after shade even when modular compiles look fine
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the relocation prefix and JNI class turns the shade locus into a string-replace recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: sieve_c writes native reachability metadata that keeps only the boot entry type and omits the SPI provider plus NativeHook reflective/JNI entries the native probe requires for reflect_kept and native status
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Listing the missing reachability entries removes the Graal-metadata discovery the task tests.
